description: The power of scheming; Groups scheme and plot, spies and informants trade and share information and secrets, kings are assassinated, black markets are formed, secret alliances are made, etc. Anything that happens as part of a complex plot, or plans that are set in motion only to be triggered later, ongoing things in the world. Schemes can be internal to a society or involve multiple societies.
fantasticalDescription: The power of fantastical scheming; magical plots, divine schemes, etc.
